$comment: Every content message key, in the default locale.

messages.content.ammo.hybrid.small.iron.descripti: Kinetic damage and the longest reach a small railgun has.
messages.content.ammo.hybrid.small.iron.name: Iron Charge S
messages.content.ammo.hybrid.small.plasma.descrip: Thermal damage up close, trading away range.
messages.content.ammo.hybrid.small.plasma.name: Plasma Charge S
messages.content.ammo.projectile.small.fusion.des: Heavy explosive damage at close range.
messages.content.ammo.projectile.small.phased.des: Thermal damage and more reach, at the cost of raw punch.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.pirate-base.de: Two gunners and a warden around a cradle of scrap, with a marksman watching from range. The gunners outrun an unboosted light hull and hit hard up close; the warden carries two guns of its own and repairs its armour while its capacitor lasts. Their phased rounds still bite at 10 km, so a ship that controls the range - or outranges them - chooses the fight. A starter fit will not survive this one.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.pirate-base.re: The largest bounties in Borrell, and the best salvage: circuitry, armour plating, capacitor batteries and sometimes a railgun.
Two cutters and a marksman holding a lane. The cutters close fast with two guns each, and their shields shrug off explosive rounds. The marksman sits far off and will not come to you. Decide what you kill first.
A bounty for each of the three pirates. Their wrecks carry salvage and ammunition, and now and then an afterburner or armour plating.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.pirate-scout.d: A lone pirate watching the belt. One opponent, close range, nothing the ship you were given cannot handle.
messages.content.encounter.borrell.pirate-scout.r: A bounty for the pirate, and whatever survives in its wreck: salvage to sell and sometimes a few fusion rounds.
messages.content.guide.loop.carry-rounds.body: Your autocannon's magazine holds 20 rounds, and a fight takes more. Open the Hangar (G) and use Move to hold on the Fusion S rounds: a gun reloads only from the ship's hold, never from the station.
messages.content.guide.loop.carry-rounds.title: Carry spare rounds
messages.content.guide.loop.choose-site.body: Open Departure (U). Every site shows its tier, its opponents and what it pays. Choose the Pirate Scout: one opponent, and the ship you were given can beat it.
messages.content.guide.loop.choose-site.title: Choose a site
messages.content.guide.loop.clear.body: Destroy every opponent. The Encounter panel tracks what is left and the bounty paid for each kill, straight into your wallet.
messages.content.guide.loop.clear.title: Clear the site
messages.content.guide.loop.completed: You have flown the whole loop. The sites stay open - replay them for credits, or try the Pirate Base when your fit is ready for it.
messages.content.guide.loop.defend.body: Toggle the booster with 1 when your shield starts to drop. Each cycle costs capacitor - watch it in Your ship. An empty capacitor stops the booster, so switch it off once the shield is safe.
messages.content.guide.loop.defend.title: Run your shield booster
messages.content.guide.loop.fire.body: Fire (E) sends every weapon that can shoot at the locked target. The Weapons panel shows your hit chance and whether range or tracking is holding it down.
messages.content.guide.loop.fire.title: Open fire
messages.content.guide.loop.harder.body: The Pirate Patrol sends two fast cutters and a marksman: kill the cutters first, then chase the marksman. At the Pirate Base, keep range and always fight the nearest brawler. Tier is advice, not a gate.
messages.content.guide.loop.harder.title: Try a harder site
messages.content.guide.loop.intro: A few steps take you through the whole loop: pick a fight, win it, bring the spoils home and turn them into a better ship. Do them in any order; skip any you already know.
messages.content.guide.loop.lock.body: With the pirate selected, Lock target (L) once it is inside your lock range - until then the button says why it cannot. Locking takes a few seconds; the Locks panel counts it down and shows the formula behind it.
messages.content.guide.loop.lock.title: Lock a target
messages.content.guide.loop.loot.body: Select a wreck and Approach it at 0.5 km. Once in reach, Take all (T) moves what fits into your hold. Wrecks do not last forever.
messages.content.guide.loop.loot.title: Loot the wreck
messages.content.guide.loop.move.body: Select a pirate in the view or the list (] steps through them), then Orbit (O), Approach (A) or Keep range (K) at the distance in the range box. You command the ship; it flies itself.
messages.content.guide.loop.move.title: Give a movement order
messages.content.guide.loop.ready.body: In Services (R), repair and resupply. Then let time run until the capacitor is nearly full: it recharges only while the clock runs, docked or not, and a ship that undocks empty cannot run its booster.
messages.content.guide.loop.ready.title: Get the ship ready
messages.content.guide.loop.return.body: Retreat (X) warps you home; then Dock (D). Retreat works mid-fight too: leaving a site is always allowed, and the pirates do not follow.
messages.content.guide.loop.return.title: Return and dock
messages.content.guide.loop.sell.body: Open the Market (M) and sell salvage you cannot use. Keep modules and ammunition your next fit wants - the hold's contents are listed there too.
messages.content.guide.loop.sell.title: Sell your loot
messages.content.guide.loop.title: Flight school
messages.content.guide.loop.undock.body: Open Departure (U) and press Undock. The station warns you first about anything a fight would punish, such as a gun with no ammunition, and shows how charged your capacitor is.
messages.content.guide.loop.undock.title: Undock
messages.content.guide.loop.upgrade.body: Buy an upgrade at the Market - a second autocannon is the first big step - then open Fitting (F), Change fit, put it in a slot and Apply fit. The Ship view shows what changed and why.
messages.content.guide.loop.upgrade.title: Improve the fit
messages.content.guide.loop.warp.body: In space, set Arrive at to 10 km, then Warp (W) to the site you chose. Nothing moves while the clock is paused, so Resume (P) if it is. From farther out the flight in takes minutes; at 10 km the pirate comes to you.
messages.content.guide.loop.warp.title: Warp to the site
messages.content.hull.independent.starter.descrip: An independent light hull sold at every neutral station. It does nothing outstandingly well and nothing badly, which is what makes it the ship a pilot starts and restarts in.
messages.content.hull.independent.starter.name: Wayfarer
messages.content.hull.independent.starter.trait.v: Fits any small weapon and enough support to survive a mistake.
messages.content.hull.pirate.raider.description: A heavier pirate hull carrying armour and a second gun, and quicker than it looks.
messages.content.hull.pirate.raider.name: Corsair
messages.content.hull.pirate.raider.trait.armoure: Armoured, faster than an unboosted light hull and willing to trade hits.
messages.content.hull.pirate.scout.description: A stripped-down pirate hull that trades armour for speed.
messages.content.hull.pirate.scout.name: Cutlass
messages.content.hull.pirate.scout.trait.fast: Fast, fragile and hard to hit at range.
messages.content.item.commodity.coolant.descripti: Station-grade coolant. Always bought, never scarce for long.
messages.content.item.commodity.coolant.name: Reactor Coolant
messages.content.item.salvage.alloy.description: Scorched hull plating. Worth something to a station foundry.
messages.content.item.salvage.alloy.name: Burned Alloy Plate
messages.content.item.salvage.circuitry.descripti: Targeting electronics, mostly intact. Stations buy these.
messages.content.item.salvage.circuitry.name: Charred Circuitry
messages.content.module.capacitor.battery.small.d: Adds capacitor capacity, which lengthens how long active modules can keep running.
messages.content.module.plating.armor.small.descr: Passive resistance across every damage type. It needs no capacitor and never stops working.
messages.content.module.plating.armor.small.name: Small Armour Plating
messages.content.module.propulsion.afterburner.sm: Raises maximum speed while it cycles, which changes both how quickly you close and how well guns track you.
messages.content.module.repair.armor.small.descri: Restores armour at the end of each cycle. Strong recovery for a heavy capacitor cost.
messages.content.module.repair.armor.small.name: Small Armour Repairer
messages.content.module.shield.booster.small.desc: Restores shield at the end of each cycle, faster than an armour repairer but hungrier still.
messages.content.module.shield.booster.small.name: Small Shield Booster
messages.content.module.turret.autocannon.small.d: A short-range projectile turret. It draws no capacitor and hits fast-moving targets well inside its optimal range.
messages.content.module.turret.railgun.small.desc: A long-range hybrid turret. It reaches far beyond an autocannon but tracks a close, fast target poorly.
messages.content.module.turret.railgun.small.name: 75mm Railgun

messages.content.notify.combat.hull-damaged: Your hull is taking damage - the ship is close to destruction.
messages.content.notify.combat.lock-out-of-range: Lock on {target} lost: it moved out of lock range.
messages.content.notify.combat.propulsion-starved: {module} is waiting: not enough capacitor to run it.
messages.content.notify.combat.weapon-idle: {module} has reloaded but is not firing. Fire again to use it.
messages.content.notify.combat.weapon-starved: {module} stopped: not enough capacitor for its next cycle.
messages.content.notify.encounter.completed: {encounter} cleared. Loot the wrecks, then warp home and dock.
messages.content.notify.encounter.wreck: A wreck is ready to loot.
messages.content.notify.navigation.docked: {station}: docked. Repairs, resupply and the market are open.
messages.content.notify.navigation.low-capacitor: You undocked with {percent}% capacitor. It recharges only while time runs - docked or in space.
messages.content.notify.recovery.ship-granted: The recovery service supplied a starter ship with its original fit.
messages.content.notify.recovery.ship-lost: Your {hull} was destroyed. The loss report at the station explains why.

messages.content.station.borrell.harbour.descript: An independent harbour station. It sells what a pilot needs to start again and asks no questions about standings.
